//: Community compatibility patch for Complete Crafting Overhaul Remastered (CCOR): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/28608 . Translates the logic of that mod's own 'CCOR Compatibility Script v2_4.pas' xEdit script (by matortheeternal, kryptopyr, danielleonyett) into RecipeConditionPatcher's classifiers feature, so any installed mod's recipes get tagged with the matching CCO_* global-variable conditions automatically at game load, without needing to run the xEdit script and build a patch plugin. Drop this file into Data/SKSE/Plugins/ alongside RecipeConditionPatcher.json (it only takes effect if both this mod and CCOR are installed; the CCO_* globals it references simply won't resolve otherwise, which is harmless, see the README). Only mappings/recipeOverrides/classifiers are read from this file; RecipeConditionPatcher's own settings are unaffected.

CCOR: clothing subtype: forge + tanning rack
CCOR: non-clothing armor slot: forge + tanning rack

rules.comment: default for any other non-clothing armor slot

classifiers.comment: CCOR: weapon type: forge only (no default; a weapon matching none of these keeps whatever it already had)

rules.comment: upstream CCOR v2.4 checks HasKeyword against its own global names here (CCO_WeapDaggerRecipes etc.), which can never match any real keyword. Fixed here to check the actual WeapType* keywords those globals are meant to gate on
